scenario.name: Altadena Boxwork EVA
notes: Real rover waypoints and Mastcam frames; terrain physics fields are a modeled twin.
PLSS energy is a metabolic-energy-equivalent consumable budget, not a battery state-of-charge.
Acute RAD dose is an operational scenario, not a mission medical forecast.

site.name: Mount Sharp / Gale Crater, Mars
site.projection: local ENU metres from JPL MMGIS easting/northing

physics.reserve_rule: At every traversed node: capacity - consumed - walkback_energy >= 0.25 * capacity

stations.name: Sand Apron
stations.science_target: Low-TI sand sheet / trafficability and slip risk

stations.name: Ridge Shoulder
stations.science_target: Boxwork flank / slope and RF horizon geometry

stats.note: walkback reserve is carried on top of the 25 % PLSS floor

grid.sample: cell centres, easting/northing increasing with column/row

raster.note: Pre-cropped local rasters are optional; the calibrated twin is the fallback.

terrain.note: Real Curiosity waypoints constrain the elevation trend. Boxwork relief, THEMIS-style TI, CRISM-style D2300, TPI and RF viewshed are modeled unless local rasters are supplied in data/raw/.
terrain.comm_network: Base mast + three 12 m ridge repeaters; shadow = no ray-traced LOS.

attribution: Curiosity waypoints: NASA/JPL-Caltech, MSL MMGIS waypoint layer.
Mastcam imagery: NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS, Mars Science Laboratory raw images.
Terrain twin: ARES-WALK scenario model, calibrated to real waypoint elevations.
HiRISE/THEMIS/CRISM references: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona and ASU.
ai_disclosure: ARES-WALK was scaffolded and implemented with an AI coding agent under human direction. Physics, data provenance and limitations are documented in README.md.
